text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin pulled off a splendid 
result in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the radiant, clear sky—the BNW 
trio dashed across the turf once again 
today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Just as I foresaw! On the next corner...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOH!! THE DEEEEEERBYYYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Uh, you do realize the Derby is 
already long over, right?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that doesn't change the fact that 
the Derby is the stage of dreams!!”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, shouting 'Derby' really does 
give me a burst of energyーーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Stating one's resolve to stoke 
fighting spirit and enhance physical 
performance, is it—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll try putting it into practice 
next time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If what Ticket says is true, it should be 
worth a try.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, my little sister told me, 
'Losing all the time isn't like you, 
Sis.'"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's the spirit, Hayahide!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin might've won the Arima Kinen, but 
I won't lose next time~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Our race starts right hereeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief, that Ticket.
choice_data_list:
I'm glad Taishin looks like she's having 
fun

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, whenever anything 
happened, she'd make a fuss about running, 
running...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it does count as training, I 
guess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Narita Taishin talks snarkily, her 
expression is gentle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after the Twinkle Series came to a 
close, her two rivals and friends seem to 
still have a positive influence on her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...And? Which race are you entering next?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just say the word. ...I'll show you I can 
win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The path I walk with Narita Taishin will 
continue. —From now on, always.
